title: _carryBuffer staticcalls setAsideBufferRecipient() — selector absent from deployed old DOLA/USDC ERC4626YieldStrategy bytecode, fatal ABI-decode revert bricks migrate:saga2.1-deploy (deployed-ABI drift)
description: MigrateSaga2Deploy._carryBuffer staticcalls setAsideBufferRecipient() (selector 0x88b57777) on the deployed old DOLA/USDC ERC4626YieldStrategy. That getter is absent from the deployed strategy bytecode, so the staticcall returns empty data and the ABI decode reverts. The revert fires inside the broadcast block (before any phUSD mint-authority swap or setMigrator), so the entire 2.1 deployment aborts dead-on-arrival and the time-critical saga (2.2/2.3) is blocked.
impact: Protocol function/availability: the entire MigrateSaga2Deploy script reverts on every run against the live deployment; the 2.1 deployment cannot execute and the whole Saga 2 is blocked. No direct asset loss — old strategies and the V1 minter retain all principal and mint authority unchanged; forge simulate-then-broadcast means zero transactions are dispatched on revert (atomic, fail-loud, no split-brain).
attackPath: Owner runs migrate:saga2.1-deploy against live mainnet.
_carryBuffer staticcalls setAsideBufferRecipient() (0x88b57777) on the deployed old DOLA/USDC strategy.
The getter is absent in deployed bytecode -> empty-data return -> ABI decode revert.
The transaction reverts atomically during simulation; no state is broadcast; the migration is dead-on-arrival.
recommendation: Do not call a getter that the deployed bytecode does not expose. Read the carry-forward buffer parameters via the ABI the deployed strategy actually implements (confirm the exact deployed interface against on-chain bytecode), or pass the values in as script inputs. Add a pre-flight that probes selector support and fails with a clear diagnostic before entering the broadcast block.

evidence.observed: Fork preview reproduces the revert; script never proceeds past _carryBuffer.
evidence.atomicity: Revert occurs in-simulation inside vm.startBroadcast()/vm.stopBroadcast(); forge dispatches no transactions; no authority swap, no setMigrator, no handoff JSON written.

downgradeReason: Guaranteed fail-loud atomic revert with no broadcast — no assets stolen/lost/compromised and no exploit path. C4 Medium (protocol function/availability impacted). Severity-auditor CONFIRM (high confidence).
faithfulnessNote: Script does not do what the migration intent states (carry the buffer forward); routed to F-XX spec-conformance while retaining honest Medium per Law 1.
